solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses **organizations planning to take action regarding enhancing employee experience in the future.**
 
• The **appropriate verb **should convey a deliberate action or plan to improve employee experience.
 
• "**Intend**" **fits well** as it means to plan or aim to do something, aligning with the idea of organizations planning future actions..

The correct word for fill in the blanks no. 5 is **"****About a third of those who haven't done so intend__ to do so in the next 12 months......"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Other options ("pose", "pretend", "enact") do not fit the context as effectively. 

 
• **Pose** (दिखावा करना): "Pose" means to present or constitute, which does not convey the idea of planning an action.
 
• **Pretend **(नाटक करना): "Pretend" means to act as if something is true when it is not, which does not fit the context of planning or intending.
 
• **Enact** (अधिनियमित करना): "Enact" means to make into a law, which does not align with the context of planning to improve employee experience in the future.
